name: 11725 · Commack, NY
findings: ZIP 11725 (Commack) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11725 (Commack) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
